name: RAC3-Style Jumping (Experimental)
author: glawks
description: RAC3-inspired RAC1 jump tuning: verified standing-jump height parameters, optional Heli/Thruster parity tweaks, and jump-height diagnostics.

settings.name: RAC3-style standing jump
settings.description: Uses RAC3's documented short/held standing-jump targets (1.42 / 2.70 units); does not change running jumps.

settings.name: Match Thruster high jump to Heli-Pack
settings.description: Experimental compensation for the Thruster-Pack's shorter high jump.

settings.name: Thruster high-jump bonus
settings.description: Extra target height for Thruster high jump, on top of the common adjustment. Tune using logs.

settings.name: Both packs: extra high-jump height
settings.description: Optional additional high-jump height for both packs; no measured RAC3 high-jump target yet.

settings.name: Match Heli double jump to Thruster-Pack
settings.description: Experimental early-rise vertical boost based on RAC1 Thruster physics.

settings.name: Both packs: extra double-jump height
settings.description: Optional common double-jump boost; leave at 0 until RAC3 height is measured.

settings.name: Log jump heights
settings.description: Report jump peaks for standing, running, high and double jumps; helpful for tuning.
